title: BCAB 1884 - Reduction of required doorway width and obstruction of access to the doorway

facts.text: The subject is a proposed water- closet room to be constructed in a dwelling unit. The dimensions of the water-closet room space are 0.76 m x 1.34 m, (1.02 m2), with a ceiling height of 2.1 m for the entire area. The water-closet room doorway is closed by a sliding door (barn door) outside the room. Shown in the sketch below, the front edge of the water-closet projects past the doorway opening.
The local authority has determined there are two non-compliant matters:
facts.locator: Decision being appealed / local authority position, paragraph 1

facts.text: The appellant does not consider the protrusion of the water-closet impairs the entry, use, maintenance or cleaning and exiting from the area. The appellant is unaware of any Building Code requirements that support the local authority’s determinations of non-compliance.
